note: Human-reviewed EVOLVE tasks for the self-hosted harness editing skill; usage-derived additions are staged separately for review.

intent: A repeated failure is caused by ambiguous target-agent wording. Identify the smallest harness component and validation needed for a prompt-only fix.
reference: Edit a file under harness/prompts, keep the frozen manifest unchanged, and run ci-lab harness validate.

intent: A repeatable procedure is missing from the harness. Propose where it belongs without widening any tool access.
reference: Add the procedure to an existing harness/skills/*/SKILL.md and validate the harness tree.

intent: An agent spec has an ineffective description but its terminal tool and bindings are correct. State the safe edit constraints.
reference: Change only the agent description or instructions source; keep the terminal submit tool and every required binding.

intent: A harness agent uses too many turns. Propose a bounded structural change without exceeding frozen caps.
reference: Tighten harness/loops/loops.yaml below the frozen caps and validate the candidate tree.

intent: A tool description encourages unnecessary calls. Explain the allowed tool-surface edit.
reference: Narrow the description in harness/tools/tools.yaml; do not add bindings or remove the terminal tool.

intent: An agent is exposed to an MCP tool it does not need. Propose the safe harness change.
reference: Narrow harness/mcp/exposure.yaml; never change the frozen MCP registry or source code.

intent: A target workflow has a redundant step. State the legal workflow edit and checks.
reference: Edit harness/workflows/*.yaml using only allowed agent/function executors and validate the tree.

intent: A proposed harness improvement requires changing harness.yaml and src/ci_lab. Explain the correct response.
reference: Refuse both frozen changes and find an owned candidate surface under harness instead.

intent: A proposal asks for persistent memory even though the frozen manifest has no memory file surface. State the safe action.
reference: Do not invent a memory path; use an implemented owned harness component or return no edit.
